description_en: Retrieves the details of a folder copy asynchronous node based on the AsyncTaskId parameter returned by the CopyCdsFile operation
description_zh: 根据CopyCdsFile接口获得的AsyncTaskId返回参数获取文件夹复制异步任务的详细信息
name: GetAsyncTask

parameters.help_en: The asynchronous task ID. When you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247626.html operation to copy a folder, this field is returned because the copy is performed asynchronously in the background. Call this operation and pass in the asynchronous task ID to retrieve the task details
parameters.help_zh: 异步任务ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247626.html接口复制文件夹时，因为是后台异步复制，所以会返回该字段。调用本接口并传入该异步任务ID即可获取任务详细信息
parameters.name: async_task_id

Code.description_en: The execution result. A value of `success` indicates success. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 执行结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息

ConsumedProcess.description_en: The total number of items that have been processed by the asynchronous task, such as the number of files that have been packaged for a server-side package download task
ConsumedProcess.description_zh: 异步任务已处理总量，如服务端打包下载已打包的文件量

ErrCode.description_en: The error code of the asynchronous task

Message.description_en: The error message of the asynchronous task
Message.example: The request failed due to some unknown errors. Please try again later.

TotalProcess.description_en: The total number of items to be processed by the asynchronous task, such as the number of files to be packaged for a server-side package download task
TotalProcess.description_zh: 异步任务需处理总量，如服务端打包下载需打包的文件量

Url.description_en: The download URL of the data generated by the asynchronous task, such as the download URL generated by a server-side package download task
Url.description_zh: 异步任务生成数据的下载地址，如服务端打包下载任务生成下载地址

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful
